thread:
jamal: quick capture from the cross-region postmortem—we have 3 action lanes: routing policy drift, snapshot/restore reliability, and runbook clarity. pulling owners and short ETAs here so we can close before next game-day.

maria: can we list owners now? i'll collate into the DR tracker.

chris: i'll own routing policy drift audit (verify ramp steps, fallback priority, and edge health-probe windows). creating TSK-9633. ETA: Thu EOD. quick checks i'll run:
```
gcloud compute url-maps describe redwood-ingress --region=eu-west1
kubectl -n infra get svc router-probe -o yaml
```

leo: eng-runtime will help surface KV-cache warmup and cross-region p95 telemetry for INC-4567. TSK-9634 -> ETA: Wed EOD.

sara: i'll own snapshot/restore reliability and checksum mismatch triage. creating TSK-9635. plan: reserved restore slot + repeat restores to reproduce. ETA: Mon 18:00 UTC.

maria: i'll own runbook edits (explicit quiesce window, shard-verify, and a decision tree for partial vs full restore). TSK-9636. ETA: Tue 10:00 UTC.

jamal: good. ops-bot, tag next rehearsal when tasks are ready.

ops-bot: calendarbot: Noted. Will create DR rehearsal event when all TSK-9633/9634/9635/9636 are marked ready. :spiral_calendar:

chris: note—routing diffs show inconsistencies between infra repo and live url-map for fallback priority. i'll include safe rollback commands and a smoke-test plan in TSK-9633.

sara: observed ~10% restores with transient checksum mismatch on partial shard replay. mitigation candidate: pre-verify shards + retry-with-backoff. adding sample logs to the ticket.

leo: telemetry ask: need eng-sre to expose route-weight change events and edge 5xx spike markers so we can correlate. tagging eng-sre in TSK-9634.

maria: runbook will include a 5-step pre-restore checklist and a 3-decision flowchart. will add a short test script for the rehearsal.

jamal: summary for DR tracker:
- TSK-9633 routing audit -> chris -> Thu EOD
- TSK-9635 restore reliability -> sara -> Mon 18:00 UTC
- TSK-9636 runbook edits -> maria -> Tue 10:00 UTC
- TSK-9634 telemetry/dashboard -> leo/eng-runtime -> Wed EOD

chris: will add a dashboard tile for cross-region p95 vs route-weight delta and a play to revert to previous url-map commit.

sara: i'll schedule a dedicated throughput window for restores and post timings to the ticket.

jamal: please update each ticket with a 1-line test step before EOD tomorrow so we can validate during the rehearsal. i'll be incident lead for the practice run. thanks. :thumbsup:
